notes.title: Randomice is participating in the Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes: [previewyoutube="6hVJqBneSls;full"][/previewyoutube][h1]Try out the Randomice demo during the Steam Next Fest[/h1][p]Randomice is participating in the Steam Next Fest![/p][p]It’s an opportunity to give the game demo a(nother) look:[/p][list][*][p][b]30 minutes minimum of gameplay[/b] for a first run[/p][/*][*][p][b]8 powers[/b] to find and try out![/p][/*][*][p][b]4 house rooms[/b] to explore from top to bottom[/p][/*][*][p][b]6 wacky characters[/b] to meet and help[/p][/*][*][p][b]5 Steam achievements[/b] to start collecting, including 3 demo-exclusives![/p][/*][/list][p]With the challenges, you can replay the second day of the demo with [b]another random object distribution[/b]. Will you be able to beat this second day in less than 7 minutes?[/p][p][/p][h2]Special demo for content creators[/h2][p]You’re a content creator and you want to try out Randomice? I’ve created a [b]90-minute-long extended version of the demo[/b] just for you![/p][p]To access it, contact my publisher [url="https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/Abiding-Bridge"]Abiding Bridge[/url] directly at [/p][p][url="https://communication@abidingbridge.com"]communication@abidingbridge.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880197/f92207c8f64ae84f831c6b58b48947321e30e783.png"][/img][/p][h1]Discord server and keys up for grab[/h1][p]There’s a Randomice [url="https://discord.com/invite/GaKJXyfEm6"]Discord server[/url] 🐭 There’s several of you challenging each other in the game, it’s the perfect place to give me your feedback, discuss your runs or bring up bugs.[/p][p]For every 1000 wishlists, I’ll do a prize draw among server members to give a complete game key, so don’t forget to join us and add Randomice to your wishlist![/p][p][/p][h1]Spanish and Chinese translation[/h1][p]I’m very happy to announce that Randomice is also available in Spanish and Chinese![/p]

notes.title: Wholesome Games X Randomice
notes.notes:
Randomice is part of this Wholesome Games Steam Celebration, and it's full of mice!
There's only one explanation: they appreciated the game so much they put mice everywhere on the official art.

[b]Thanks Wholesome Games![/b]

For this event, the demo is back online, updated with the latest updates and changes made to the game in the last months. Share this to your friends and make the community grow!

If you want to play more, join the Discord and ask for a Steam key to discover more of the house.

[previewyoutube=-qLC_AFU4Bo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Play my Next Fest Demo Now!
notes.notes:
The time has finally come! I'm very excited to announce that my newest demo for Randomice is live!
[previewyoutube=KTKMXx8qwuQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What’s in the demo?[/h3]
[list][*] Wreak havoc in the house with a lighter and firecrackers.
[*] Traverse the rooms quickly with a magnetic grapple and a rocket.
[*] Each run is different and procedurally generated, taking place in hand-crafted rooms.
[*] French and English translations.[/list]

Head over to the store page to play the demo NOW!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2835650/Randomice/

I would love to know what you think about my demo. Every bit of feedback that I get goes into making my game the best that it can be. You can post your feedback in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2835650/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url], on [url=https://discord.gg/822hxJPy46]Discord[/url] or email me at feedback@videoludid.com

Make sure you follow me on [url=https://x.com/Videoludid]X/Twitter[/url] for more updates.
